the transmissibility estimation in small-scale outbreaks is higher than that in large-scale outbreaks and that the normal distribution, delta distribution and gamma distribution models overestimate the reproduction number.

the mean R of the influenza outbreaks in schools in Changsha, a large city in south-central China, was 3·0, with the s.d. of 1·6.

the R of influenza in schools is higher than in a community and that the epidemic model seems to more easily estimate the R of influenza compared to the normal distribution model, delta distribution and gamma distribution models.
